import numpy as np

        'note': 'Simulator service did not accept a connection; no scene observation or robot action was possible.'

for cam, img in obs.last.items():
    Image.fromarray(img).save(out / f'initial_{cam}.png')
for cam, d in obs.last_depth.items():
    np.save(out / f'initial_depth_{cam}.npy', d)
print(json.dumps({'base':r.base,'spec':spec,'meta':obs.meta},indent=2))
